question: Where was the oath-taking ceremony of the provisional government held on 17 April 1971?

options.text: At Baidyanathtala, a mango orchard near Meherpur, later renamed Mujibnagar
At the Ramna Race Course in Dhaka

explanation: The ceremony took place on 17 April at Baidyanathtala, a mango orchard in the Meherpur area near the border. The place was then renamed Mujibnagar.
